items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: And Louis DeMere was a trumpet player, and Celestan was a trumpet player.

ctx.x: You see, sometimes they'd use him on baritone, sometimes they'd use him on bass. I see. And Louis DeMere was a trumpet player, and Celestan was a trumpet player. And they used to use lavender occasion, used to use Peter Bocard. I think Peter Bocard was once a member. Mm-hmm. He was a regular member of the band. And they had Sonny Henry on trombone. I can't play swells with Pam Trombone on the side.
Did you know Louis Armstrong down here?
